subtitle: How Kiyamba Bound Manipur to Time

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of palace terrace overlooking misty valley and river
panels.action: Meidingu Senbi Kiyamba stands in regal armour and shawl on the ramparts of Kangla, one hand resting on a carved stone slab, the other pointing toward distant hills where dawn light breaks over the Kabaw Valley.

dialogue.text: In Kiyamba’s time, Manipur did something few kingdoms dared: it chained its kings to dates, and began a chronicle that would remember when empires forgot.

i18n.hi: कियाम्बा के दौर में मणिपुर ने हिम्मत की – राजाओं को तारीखों से जकड़ दिया, ऐसा इतिवृत्त लिखा जो साम्राज्यों की भूली यादें भी सँभाले।

panels.shot: tight three-quarter view inside dim archive room, slow push-in
panels.action: Older Meidingu Senbi Kiyamba leans over a low wooden desk in a torchlit chamber, palm on palm-leaf manuscripts, Meitei-script lines faintly etched, a shallow bronze lamp casting long shadows on the walls.

dialogue.text: We remember Kiyamba for battles and temples, but his sharpest weapon was ink: under him, Manipur’s royal story began to march year by year, instead of drifting in legend.

i18n.hi: हम कियाम्बा को युद्धों और मंदिरों से याद करते हैं, पर उसकी सबसे तेज तलवार स्याही थी – उसके राज में मणिपुर की कहानी दंतकथा से निकलकर साल दर साल चलने लगी।

panels.shot: wide aerial of valley plain with two camps facing each other
panels.action: A younger Kiyamba in light armour sits astride a horse at the edge of a Manipuri war camp, banners fluttering, as across the flat Kabaw Valley the Shan host of Pong forms lines under their own standard.

dialogue.text: Before the dates came the dust of war. In the fifteenth century, Kiyamba joined the Shan king of Pong, marched west into the Kabaw Valley, and broke the power of Kyang.

i18n.hi: तारीखों से पहले सिर्फ युद्ध की धूल थी। पंद्रहवीं सदी में कियाम्बा शान राजा पोंग के साथ मिला, कबाव घाटी की ओर बढ़ा और क्यांग की ताकत तोड़ दी।

panels.shot: medium shot at field encampment, evening light, contemplative
panels.action: In the quiet after battle, Kiyamba sits on a simple stool beneath a tree at the edge of the Kabaw camp, armour loosened, looking at a wrapped bundle being presented by a Shan envoy kneeling before him.

dialogue.text: The Cheitharol Kumbaba, the court chronicle, later tells a solemn tale: the Shan ally gifted Kiyamba a sacred stone from the conquered land, a token that would change his kingdom’s worship.

i18n.hi: दरबारनामा ‘चैथारोल कुम्बाबा’ बाद में गंभीर कहानी सुनाता है – शान साथी ने जीती हुई धरती से एक पवित्र पत्थर कियाम्बा को भेंट किया, जो उसके राज्य की पूजा बदल देगा।

panels.shot: close-up on Kiyamba’s hands unveiling object, low warm light
panels.action: Close on Kiyamba’s strong hands gently unfolding layered cloths to reveal a smooth dark stone with worn carvings, lamplight glinting off its surface as his face, half in shadow, regards it with cautious curiosity.

dialogue.text: The stone, called Pheiya in the tradition, stands between story and record. Later temples, idols and inscriptional habits grow around it, but no eyewitness account names it as such.

i18n.hi: वह पत्थर, परंपरा में ‘फेइया’ कहलाया, कथा और दस्तावेज़ के बीच खड़ा है। बाद के मंदिर, मूर्तियाँ और शिलालेख उसके इर्द-गिर्द उगते हैं, पर किसी चश्मदीद ने उसे ऐसे नाम से नहीं पुकारा।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of Bishnupur hill with temple rising
panels.action: On a low hill at Bishnupur, artisans and labourers raise stone pillars and beams, scaffolding clinging to a rising shrine, while Kiyamba watches from a shaded platform, gesturing toward the sanctum under construction.

dialogue.text: Tradition links the Pheiya stone to a new shrine at Bishnupur. Around 1475, the court chronicle and later memory bind Kiyamba’s name to a Vishnu temple on that hill.

i18n.hi: परंपरा फेइया पत्थर को बिश्नुपुर के नए मंदिर से जोड़ती है। करीब १४७५ में दरबारनामा और बाद की स्मृति कियाम्बा को उस पहाड़ी के विष्णु मंदिर से बाँध देती है।

panels.shot: intimate medium shot inside unfinished sanctum, soft side light
panels.action: Inside the half-built sanctum, Kiyamba stands beside a simple pedestal as stone carvers work in the background; he looks up toward an imagined idol-space, expression thoughtful and slightly wary.

dialogue.text: Here, the older animist traditions of the valley met a new Vaishnavite presence. The chronicles do not show sudden conversion, but they do place Kiyamba near a growing cult of Vishnu.

i18n.hi: यहीं घाटी की पुरानी प्राणवादी आस्थाएँ नए वैष्णव प्रभाव से टकराईं। इतिवृत्त अचानक धर्मपरिवर्तन नहीं दिखाते, पर कियाम्बा को उभरते विष्णु-भक्ति केंद्र के पास रखते हैं।

panels.shot: wide palace courtyard scene, bustling yet focused
panels.action: In the open courtyard of Kangla, Brahmin migrants with sacred threads and palm-leaf bundles stand before Kiyamba on a raised throne; courtiers in traditional Meitei attire watch as he gestures for them to be seated.

dialogue.text: Around this time, as scholars like Thokchom Jayanti note, Brahmins arrived and settled. They brought liturgy, astrology and the habit of fixing rites to specific days and months.

i18n.hi: इसी समय, जैसा विद्वान ठोकचोम जयंती बताते हैं, ब्राह्मण आए और बस गए। वे पूजा-विधि, ज्योतिष और रस्मों को खास दिन और महीनों से बाँधने की आदत लेकर आए।

panels.shot: medium shot over Kiyamba’s shoulder toward a court scribe
panels.action: Over Kiyamba’s shoulder, a court scribe sits cross-legged before a low desk, reed stylus in hand, as he looks up attentively at the king, a blank palm leaf ready before him.

dialogue.speaker: meidingu_senbi_kiyamba
dialogue.text: If the gods count our days, why should we not number our reign?

i18n.hi: जब देवता हमारे दिन गिनते हैं, तो हम अपने राज क्यों न गिनें?

panels.shot: close-up on palm leaf as stylus scratches, stylised macro view
panels.action: An extreme close view of a palm leaf as a stylus etches neat Meitei-script characters, with Kiyamba’s hand steadying the leaf from above, the first lines of a formal entry just taking shape.

dialogue.text: The Cheitharol Kumbaba begins earlier, but its early stretch is a mist of names and episodes. Under Kiyamba, around 1485, something changes: entries start to lock themselves to a year count called Cheithaba.

i18n.hi: ‘चैथारोल कुम्बाबा’ पहले से शुरू होता है, पर शुरुआती हिस्सा नामों और किस्सों की धुंध है। कियाम्बा के नीचे, लगभग १४८५ में, कुछ बदलता है – प्रविष्टियाँ ‘चैथाबा’ नाम की साल-गिनती से चिपकने लगती हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot inside court hall with large board or chart on floor
panels.action: Inside the royal hall, Kiyamba crouches with advisers around a long cloth laid on the floor, marked in lines and notches like a calendar, as he points to one notch while a priest counts on his fingers.

dialogue.text: Cheithaba meant more than a date. It was a system for reckoning each year of a reign, a spine along which the chronicle could hang births, deaths, wars, plagues and festivals.

i18n.hi: चैथाबा सिर्फ तारीख नहीं था; राज के हर साल की गिनती का ढाँचा था, वही रीढ़ जिस पर जन्म, मृत्यु, युद्ध, बीमारी और त्योहार लटकाए जा सके।

panels.shot: dynamic montage-like wide shot of scribes working in different seasons
panels.action: In a composite courtyard view suggesting changing seasons, court scribes write by summer light, monsoon gloom and winter hearths, while an older Kiyamba occasionally appears in the background conferring with them.

dialogue.text: After about 1485, the chronicle’s heartbeat steadies. Entry follows entry, each tagged to a counted year, turning scattered memories into a continuous royal diary of Manipur.

i18n.hi: करीब १४८५ के बाद इतिवृत्त की धड़कन सँभल जाती है। एक प्रविष्टि के बाद दूसरी, हर एक गिने हुए साल से जुड़ी, बिखरी यादों को मणिपुर की लगातार शाही डायरी में बदल देती है।

panels.shot: wide shot in forested hill area near Khoibu, solemn and quiet
panels.action: On a forested slope near Khoibu, Kiyamba stands with a small entourage beside a freshly erected stone slab, its face rough but inscribed, a priest and a scribe standing by as villagers watch from a distance.

dialogue.text: The habit of fixing orders in stone spread beyond the palace. At Khoibu, a Meitei-script inscription, now in the Manipur State Museum, anchors Kiyamba’s rule in rock as well as in palm leaves.

i18n.hi: हुक्मों को पत्थर में दर्ज करने की आदत महल से बाहर फैल गई। खोइबू में मैती लिपि का एक शिलालेख, जो आज मणिपुर राज्य संग्रहालय में है, कियाम्बा के राज को सिर्फ ताड़पत्र नहीं, पत्थर में भी गाड़ देता है।

panels.shot: close-up on inscribed stone surface, raking light highlighting letters
panels.action: A close side-lit view of the Khoibu stone shows rows of incised Meitei letters, their grooves catching light and shadow, while a faint reflection of Kiyamba’s profile appears on the polished edge.

dialogue.text: Epigraphers today read those letters and align them with the Cheithaba years. So legend, chronicle and stone begin to cross-check each other, tightening the frame around Kiyamba’s life.

i18n.hi: आज के शिलालेख-विशेषज्ञ उन अक्षरों को पढ़कर उन्हें चैथाबा के सालों से मिलाते हैं। इस तरह कथा, इतिवृत्त और पत्थर एक-दूसरे को परखने लगते हैं, कियाम्बा की ज़िंदगी की रूपरेखा कसकर बाँधते हैं।

panels.shot: introspective medium close-up of older Kiyamba at dusk
panels.action: An older Kiyamba sits on the steps of the Bishnupur temple at dusk, staff resting against his knee, as he gazes out over the plain where distant fires of villages glow under a darkening sky.

dialogue.speaker: meidingu_senbi_kiyamba
dialogue.text: Wars fade. Stones crack. Will our sons still know which day this was?

i18n.hi: युद्ध मिट जाते हैं। पत्थर चटकते हैं। क्या हमारे बेटे फिर भी जान पाएँगे, यह दिन कौन सा था?

panels.shot: wide shot of later-era scholars in modern museum observing stone
panels.action: Centuries later, in a modern gallery, scholars and visitors stand before the Khoibu stone mounted on a display, some taking notes, while a faint superimposed image of Kiyamba watches from the shadows.

dialogue.text: Today, historians lean over the Cheitharol Kumbaba and the Khoibu stone, tracing dates and names that Kiyamba’s scribes once cut into leaf and rock, and Manipur’s early centuries come into focus.

i18n.hi: आज इतिहासकार ‘चैथारोल कुम्बाबा’ और खोइबू शिला पर झुके, वे तारीखें और नाम बुनते हैं जो कभी कियाम्बा के लेखकों ने पत्तों और पत्थरों पर काटे थे, और मणिपुर के शुरुआती सदी साफ नज़र आने लगते हैं।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot from above Kangla at sunrise
panels.action: From a bird’s-eye view over Kangla at sunrise, the palace, Bishnupur’s temple hill, and the distant Kabaw hills lie under a soft golden light, with a ghostly outline of Kiyamba standing at the centre, half-earth, half-legend.

dialogue.text: Kiyamba’s true monument is not only a stone or a shrine, but a decision: to let his kingdom be pinned to a calendar, so that when powers rise and fall, Manipur’s voice still speaks in dates.

i18n.hi: कियाम्बा की असली यादगार सिर्फ पत्थर या मंदिर नहीं, एक फ़ैसला है – अपने राज्य को कैलेंडर से बाँध देना, ताकि ताकतें उठें-गिरें, फिर भी मणिपुर की आवाज़ तारीखों में बोलती रहे।

title_i18n.hi: कियाम्बा ने इतिहास की शुरुआत की

subtitle_i18n.en: How Kiyamba Bound Manipur to Time
subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे कियाम्बा ने मणिपुर को समय से बाँध दिया
